translations.text: Jesus was led by the Spirit into the desert, and so on.
And then he fasted forty days and forty nights, so that he tasted neither food nor drink in all that time; but afterwards he was hungry.
"It is written, Everyone shall worship his Lord alone and serve him alone. Then the devil left him, and angels came to him and ministered to him."
Now he was so humble that he allowed the devil to tempt him, and he allowed wicked men to kill him.
When Christ fasted forty days and forty nights without a break, the devil did not tell him to eat at any time in that whole period, because he saw that he was not hungry at all.
God is so gracious to mankind that he has set his angels as guardians over us, so that they must never allow the cruel devils to be able to destroy us.
They are allowed to tempt us, but they are not allowed to force us into any evil, unless we do it ourselves of our own will, through the evil prompting of the devil.

"Then he took him again and carried him up onto a mountain, and showed him the wealth of the whole world and its glory, and said to him, All these things I will give you, if you will fall down at my feet and worship me."
"Christ then said to the devil, Get back, Satan! It is written, One shall worship his Lord and serve him alone."

So to the apostle Peter Christ says, "Get behind me," that is, Follow me. To the devil it is not said, "Get behind me," but "Get back," as we have already said; and the blessed Jerome wrote the same in one of his letters.
He could have sunk the devil into the deep abyss with a single word; but he did not show his might. Instead he answered the devil with holy scripture,
but if our mind takes pleasure in it, then we must at least resist, so that there is no consent to the evil deed.
He was overcome through gluttony when, at the devil's urging, he ate the forbidden apple.
The prophet Elijah also fasted just as long, likewise through God's power, and afterwards was taken from this life without death.
Therefore it is less dangerous for a Christian to eat meat than to have relations with a woman in this holy season.
But if you want to fast to please God, then help poor people with the portion that you deny yourself, and with more as well if you can afford it.
But let us do as God taught, so that our good works are known to people in such a way that they can see our goodness, and that they may glorify and praise our Heavenly Father,
